rung_spec.fp16: every floating-point tensor of the state_dict stored as float16; integer buffers (num_batches_tracked) stored verbatim. Dequantized to the source dtype at load.
rung_spec.int8: weight-only, per-output-channel (dim 0) SYMMETRIC int8 for every floating tensor with ndim >= 2 (conv + linear weights, 98.0-98.4% of float params on these four heads); scale_c = max|W_c|/127 stored fp32; every other floating tensor (BN affine, biases, 1-D) stored fp16. Dequantized to fp32 at load; compute is unchanged fp32. NO activation quantization and NO backend engine (fbgemm/qnnpack/TensorRT) so the recipe re-applies in a clean-room repo with standard torch on any platform.
rung_spec.hybrid: int8 as above EXCEPT named layer groups kept at fp16, chosen by a per-group sensitivity sweep (quantize one group at a time against the fp32 reference scores). Only reached if int8 fails a head's bar; the sweep is reported so the exception is attributable.

location.material: PRIMARY: 2,190 v11 eval locations at the deploy-canonical render

pref.material: 47 library locations x 12 production palette_candidates (564 frames)

notes.why_not_speed: The objective was stored bytes, never latency. backbone_search_v1 measured the backbone at 5-17% of end-to-end score time, so the deploy path is decode-bound and no rung here would be visible in throughput.
notes.why_weight_only: No activation quantization and no backend engine (fbgemm / qnnpack / TensorRT). The recipe must re-apply in a clean-room repo with standard torch on any platform, and a weight-only rung dequantized at load is the only form of that which leaves the compute graph untouched.
notes.why_per_channel: These are MobileNetV4 backbones. Their depthwise convolutions have per-channel weight ranges spanning orders of magnitude, so one scale per tensor quantizes the small channels into noise.
notes.int8_verdict: int8 weight-only is NOT near-free on any of the four heads, and on the location head it is not close: it moves AUC(>=4) by more than the entire control 3-seed retrain band the bars were calibrated against.
notes.hybrid_verdict: The per-group sweep found ONE dominant group per backbone family — conv_head on mnv4_conv_medium, blocks.2 on mnv4_conv_small — and exempting the top three recovers most of the loss. It is still not enough on three of four heads, and it cannot be pushed further: the group carrying the residual error on the location head is blocks.3, which is 63% of that backbone's parameters, so exempting it would collapse hybrid back into fp16 at a worse size.
notes.pref_exception: The pref ranker is the one head where NO rung passes. fp16 keeps its top-1 palette on every location and its top-3 set on all but two, but misses the declared mean within-location rank agreement. A single-tower margin head scores a location's candidates within a fraction of a point of each other, so full-order rank agreement is the strictest read any of the four heads is held to, and it is the read that decides this head.
notes.what_this_does_not_do: No production pin moves. Every ACTIVE checkpoint is untouched and the big-repo deploy path stays fp32. This record says what a FUTURE ship step should do with a newly-trained head.

quantized_weights_are_not_tracked: data/quant/weights is a registered bulk prefix; a quantized head is born out-of-tree and is reproducible from its source sha256 plus its rung
